summary: Iteration 2 focused on the admin-login change (hardcoded useState defaults removed) plus a public-site regression pass. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass (public payload, quote submission, login 401/200, services CRUD, dashboard metrics auth+shape, invalid-token rejection). Frontend: /admin renders with truly empty email/password fields (verified via input_value and via direct URL navigation), invalid credentials show 'E-mail ou senha inválidos', manual typing of admin@dinhorodas.com / Dinho#2026 logs in successfully, dashboard shows all 4 metric tiles (Leads 7, Orçamentos 4, Novos pendentes 4, Convertidos 0), all 8 admin tabs open, logout clears dinho_token. Homepage loads with 3 service cards and quote form submission returns the success state. Grepped frontend/src and the served JS bundle: no occurrence of the password string, so the credential leak is resolved.
action_items: Optional (low): add required + type="email" to the admin login inputs so an empty submit is blocked client-side instead of firing a 401 request
Optional (low): clear the login error state on a new submit attempt so a stale 'E-mail ou senha inválidos' message doesn't persist
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: Admin login useState now defaults to {email:'',password:''}; no credential string in frontend/src or the served bundle.

Maintainability: /app/frontend/src/App.js packs the whole app into 25 extremely long lines (Public, Admin, Dashboard, AdminList). Splitting into components/ files would make future edits far safer, though it does not affect runtime behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Created one lead/quote via API test (TEST_Ana) and one via UI (TEST_QA Playwright); both remain in the quotes collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_dinho_api.py (4 tests, all passing) now also covers /api/dashboard/metrics auth+shape and invalid-token rejection. Admin login is typed manually (no defaults). Admin data-testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-error, admin-nav-{dashboard|quotes|leads|services|testimonials|gallery|faqs|settings}, admin-logout. Direct navigation to /admin works (SPA reads window.location.pathname).
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. Prior deployment risk (admin credentials shipped in the JS bundle as useState defaults) is fixed and confirmed absent from both source and the served bundle; login still functions with manual entry.
